Mutual audit stops bulk fakes: each newcomer pairs with a random peer auditor to cross-check. The Raven draw pairs at random, so no operator picks auditors.

A whisper challenge proves each one's own history, while a zephyr heartbeat keeps them honest; copied histories trigger review, cheating burns both deposits.

Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 x 30 = 30,000 units, plus 1,000 histories; an honest agent pays 30 once and keeps its full reward.
